pages.text: Build a Pity Machine Frame, then upgrade it in a GregTech assembler with Polyethylene Plates and steel components. Open the Simple Machine Frame in JEI for the exact recipe.
The Advanced Machine Frame uses a Simple Machine Frame, aluminium, gold, Netherite Scrap and Pink Slime. Supply the assembler with both its items and fluid.
The Supreme Machine Frame builds on the Advanced frame with stainless steel, diamond, Netherite and Ether Gas. Follow the frame recipe in JEI to plan the complete production chain.
